description: A wind charge jump (#230, I3-32): a client player throws a wind charge at its feet; the explosion (ServerPlayer.onExplosionHit) sets ignoreFallDamageFromCurrentImpulse with the impact position, so the 7 block fall back to the launch height that its client's moves report does no fall damage. A second client player makes the same moves without a wind charge and takes the fall damage.
